instruction: str() of a packaging.markers.Marker drops the parentheses of a nested group when the group is written with redundant double parentheses, which can change the meaning of the marker. For example, str(Marker('python_version < "3.10" and ((sys_platform == "linux" or sys_platform == "darwin"))')) loses the parentheses around the or-group, so Marker(str(m)) evaluates differently from m. Serialize markers so that every group keeps the parentheses its and/or precedence needs, and Marker(str(m)) always evaluates the same as m, while a redundant outer wrapper still produces no extra parentheses. Add tests.
instruction_source: written from the fix commit message, linked issue and hidden tests; describes behavior, not the change
